ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across ~85% of surface area, interspersed with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters forming annular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of high-contrast white circular and semi-circular rings (annular motifs) scattered across both lobes, with specific concentrations in the central and upper distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a clear central vertex; depth is approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical pixel span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to sharpened distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of roughly circular white high-contrast pixel rings corresponding to barnacle attachment points across the entire dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions/scratches visible on the right lobe near the notch and mid-lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-pink irregular fleshy protrusion or lesion at the distal tip of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme density of uniform annular scarring covering nearly the entire visible ventral surface area.
